sloka: दीप्यमाने तु लाङ्गूले न मां दहति पावकः ।हृदयं च प्रहृष्टं मे वाताः सुरभिगन्धिनः ।। ५.५८.१६१ ।।।।
transliteration: dīpyamāne tu lāṅgūle na māṁ dahati pāvakaḥ ।hṛdayaṁ ca prahṛṣṭaṁ me vātāḥ surabhigandhinaḥ ।। 5.58.161 ।।।।

translations.english: "My tail was burning but I was not burnt by fire. There was joy in my heart. The wind carried sweet fragrance.
